monthlyUsageCalculator.title: Monthly Usage Calculator
monthlyUsageCalculator.subtitle: Tell us how your business expects to use Atlas. We will estimate actual monthly transfer, calculate charged plan usage, and suggest an allowance with room to grow.
monthlyUsageCalculator.localOnly: Private by design: answers are calculated in this page only and are never saved or sent.
monthlyUsageCalculator.subtitleRemake: Four short steps estimate your real Atlas workflows—including generated records and follow-up synchronization.

sections.businessDescription: Basic context helps us use realistic working-day assumptions.
sections.inventoryDescription: Approximate values are enough—you do not need an exact stock count.
sections.activityDescription: Enter a quantity and choose whether it happens daily, weekly, or monthly.
sections.advancedDescription: Turn this on for a more tailored estimate. It is not required.
sections.advancedOff: We will use a standard allowance for occasional history and dashboard use.
sections.businessRemakeDescription: Your role is survey context. The working schedule and team size shape recurring reads and synchronization.
sections.startingPointDescription: This captures catalog synchronization, initial setup, and existing history without asking technical database questions.
sections.workflowsDescription: Select only the workflows you need. Each one reveals a few plain-language questions.
sections.advancedRemakeDescription: Turn this on only if you know these details. The calculator uses clear standard assumptions when it is off.
sections.useAdvancedHint: Everything below remains optional and is ignored while this is off.

questions.job: What is your job or role?
questions.jobHint: Start typing to search the list, or enter your own job title.
questions.industry: What type of business is it?
questions.hours: How many hours will you use Atlas each working day?
questions.days: How many days per week is the business active?
questions.members: How many people will regularly use the workspace?
questions.storages: How many real-life storage locations do you have?
questions.storagesHint: Include shops, warehouses, branches, and stock rooms.
questions.products: About how many unique products do you keep?
questions.productsHint: Count product types or SKUs, not every physical unit.
questions.posItems: Average products in one single sale (POS)
questions.wholesaleItems: Average products in one wholesale sale order
questions.posSalesHint: Regular checkout sales made through the POS screen.
questions.wholesaleOrdersHint: Larger customer orders made through Sale Orders.
questions.invoicesHint: Do not include invoices automatically created from POS or Sale Orders.
questions.uploads: Product images, PDFs, or other files uploaded per month
questions.uploadSize: Typical size of each uploaded file (MB)
questions.membersHint: Used to estimate local caches and recurring workspace reads.
questions.historySize: Are you starting fresh or bringing existing records?
questions.historySizeHint: Estimate the combined past sales, orders, loans, and invoices already in the workspace.
questions.batchTracking: Do you track batches or expiry dates?
questions.batchTrackingHint: Atlas refreshes batch information after stock-changing workflows, so this can materially affect usage.
questions.posPayment: How are counter sales usually paid?
questions.wholesalePayment: How are wholesale orders usually paid?
questions.purchaseItems: Different products in a typical purchase order
questions.manualLoans: Loans created separately in the Loans section
questions.loanPayments: Payments recorded toward loans or installments
questions.savedInvoicesHint: Atlas stores an immutable version and a latest copy, so each saved PDF is included twice on upload.
questions.productChanges: New or changed products per month
questions.returnProfile: How often are POS sales returned or refunded?
questions.historyReviews: How often do you review past sales?
questions.reportReviews: How often do you open dashboards or reports?
questions.uploadsRemake: Product images, PDFs, or other files uploaded

results.title: Your monthly charged-usage estimate
results.empty: Complete the questions and calculate to see your estimate.
results.headroom: The recommendation includes 20% headroom above the larger first-month or busy-month estimate.
results.disclaimer: This is a planning estimate based on typical Atlas request and response sizes. Actual transfer can vary with record detail, files, refreshes, and working habits; charged usage follows the displayed multiplier.
results.noDataYet: Your typical, first, and busy month estimates will appear here.
results.range: Expected charged range: {{low}} to {{high}} depending on activity.
results.chargeExplanation: Plan usage is charged at {{multiplier}}× actual transfer: 1 MB uploaded or downloaded consumes {{multiplier}} MB of the monthly allowance.
results.breakdownDescription: Raw upload and download estimates before the {{multiplier}}× plan-usage charge.
results.generatedDescription: These are calculated automatically from your simple answers.
results.assumptionsHint: Open to see how dependencies were handled.

workflows.posDescription: Includes sale items, later history synchronization, and inventory/batch effects.
workflows.wholesaleDescription: Includes embedded order lines, inventory changes, payments, and partner summary updates.
workflows.purchasingDescription: Includes embedded product lines, inventory receipt, supplier summaries, and payments.
workflows.loansDescription: Count separate loans here. Pay-later POS and wholesale loans are inferred from the payment choices above.
workflows.invoicesDescription: Count PDFs saved or printed into Atlas. Do not count a receipt merely shown after checkout.
workflows.none: No transaction workflows selected. The estimate will cover workspace and catalog synchronization only.

summary.title: Your estimate so far
summary.dependencies: Child records and dependent operations are added automatically. You only answer questions a normal business user can understand.

assumptions.loanSchedule: Each new loan includes {{count}} generated schedule rows; every loan payment updates that full schedule.
assumptions.partners: Wholesale orders and linked loans reuse existing business partners and include their summary updates; no new partner is assumed per transaction.
assumptions.pos: POS includes the checkout RPC, sale-item children, later history sync, and full batch refreshes when batch tracking is enabled.
assumptions.orders: Order product lines are embedded in the order payload; product, payment, and partner updates are included separately.
assumptions.invoices: A saved invoice PDF is estimated at 300 KB and counted twice on upload for its version and latest copy.
assumptions.firstSync: First month includes one initial local cache and history sync for each regular workspace user.
assumptions.standardAdvanced: With optional questions off, the estimate uses occasional history/report reviews, a small return rate, and normal product changes.
assumptions.charging: Actual upload and download are modeled first. Plan recommendations then apply the fixed {{multiplier}}× charged-usage multiplier.

workspaceUsage.modalDescription: Actual data transfer and charged plan usage, with locally computed daily history and projections for this period.
workspaceUsage.title: Workspace usage: {{details}}
workspaceUsage.chargingRule: Every 1 MB of actual upload or download consumes {{multiplier}} MB of the monthly allowance. Actual transfer remains visible separately.
workspaceUsage.projectionHint: Estimate based on the current daily average
workspaceUsage.consumptionTitle: Actual transfer vs. charged usage — last 30 days
workspaceUsage.consumptionDescription: Daily values are computed locally from current-period snapshots; old period details are deleted at reset.
